problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all user accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering solutions to detect and block phishing emails
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing campaigns
detection_mechanisms: SIEM alerts for suspicious login attempts

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing attacks where attackers research and customize messages to specific individuals or roles to increase the likelihood of success.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing targeted phishing attempts
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit publicly available personal and organizational information
detection_mechanisms: Advanced email filtering with threat intelligence

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive or finance department email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual login locations or behaviors
Implement strict approval workflows for financial transactions
detection_mechanisms: SIEM alerts for anomalous email activity
Threat intelligence feeds on BEC campaigns

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets leading to unauthorized data access or leakage.
risk_reduction: Implement strict access controls and least privilege policies on cloud storage
Use automated tools to scan and remediate misconfigurations
Enable logging and monitoring of cloud storage access

problems.description: Adversaries compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency tracking
Use code signing and verify update authenticity
Conduct regular security assessments of third-party vendors

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and manipulate victims.
risk_reduction: Train employees to recognize synthetic media and verify unusual requests
Deploy AI detection tools for deepfake content
Establish multi-channel verification for sensitive communications
detection_mechanisms: Threat intelligence on emerging deepfake campaigns

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Implement robust ML model monitoring and anomaly detection
Use adversarial training techniques to harden models
detection_mechanisms: Audit logs of training data sources

problems.description: Ransomware operations offered as a service model, lowering the barrier for attackers to launch ransomware campaigns.
risk_reduction: Maintain regular, tested backups with offline storage
Deploy endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions
Implement network segmentation and least privilege access
detection_mechanisms: Network traffic analysis for ransomware behaviors
